title: 3M™ DUST RESPIRATOR MASKS – 8511 / N95 Mask / 80/CS
description: 8210 N95 Mask Maintenance free, designed for comfortable wear with reliable protection. Lightweight construc­ tion promotes greater worker acceptance and increased wear time. Applications include grinding sanding, sweeping, bagging and other dusty op­ erations. Advanced Electet® Media welded strap attachment, soft nose foam and adjustable nose clip for custom fit and secure seal. 8511 N95 Mask Uniquely designed to help provide protection against certain non-oil particles. Ideally suited for work settings that include heat, humidity or long periods of wear. Features Cool Flow® Exhalation Valve, soft inner materials and adjustable nose clip.
